tools.name: trade-finance_document-match
tools.description: Match supplied invoices to contracts, letters of credit, and trade documents by id, amount, and parties without inventing missing links. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/document-match. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-finance_letter-of-credit-discrepancy-detect
tools.description: Compare supplied LC terms with linked invoices and documents. Missing required document types are flagged only from the LC list. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/letter-of-credit-discrepancy-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-finance_invoice-financing-readiness
tools.description: Score supplied invoices for completeness of identifiers, amounts, parties, and dates. This is not a financing approval. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/invoice-financing-readiness. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-finance_receivable-aging-risk-analyze
tools.description: Bucket supplied invoice outstanding amounts by days past due from the as-of date. Missing due dates stay unlabeled. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/receivable-aging-risk-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-finance_invoice-assignment-conflict-detect
tools.description: Flag when the same invoice id or number is assigned to more than one assignee in the supplied set. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/invoice-assignment-conflict-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-finance_document-party-consistency
tools.description: Compare buyer, seller, applicant, beneficiary, shipper, and consignee fields across linked invoices, contracts, LCs, and documents. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/document-party-consistency. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-finance_export-payment-term-risk
tools.description: Label supplied payment terms as lower, moderate, higher, or unclassified from wording only. Not a credit decision. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/export-payment-term-risk. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-finance_credit-exposure-calculate
tools.description: Sum supplied outstanding or face amounts by buyer and currency. Missing amounts are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/credit-exposure-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-finance_invoice-discounting-calculate
tools.description: Calculate simple discount and proceeds from supplied face amounts, due dates, as-of date, and discount rate. Not a financing approval. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/invoice-discounting-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-finance_evidence-package
tools.description: Assemble document match, LC discrepancy, readiness, aging, assignment, party, term, exposure, and discounting summaries from the supplied set. Price $0.08 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-finance/evidence-package. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "trade-finance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trade-finance_letter-of-credit-discrepancy-detect · Private data: trade-finance_document-match, trade-finance_letter-of-credit-discrepancy-detect, trade-finance_document-party-consistency, trade-finance_evidence-package · Public sink: trade-finance_document-match, trade-finance_letter-of-credit-discrepancy-detect, trade-finance_invoice-financing-readiness, trade-finance_receivable-aging-risk-analyze, trade-finance_invoice-assignment-conflict-detect, trade-finance_document-party-consistency, trade-finance_export-payment-term-risk, trade-finance_credit-exposure-calculate, trade-finance_invoice-discounting-calculate, trade-finance_evidence-package · Destructive: trade-finance_document-match, trade-finance_letter-of-credit-discrepancy-detect, trade-finance_invoice-financing-readiness, trade-finance_receivable-aging-risk-analyze, trade-finance_invoice-assignment-conflict-detect, trade-finance_document-party-consistency, trade-finance_export-payment-term-risk, trade-finance_credit-exposure-calculate, trade-finance_invoice-discounting-calculate, trade-finance_evidence-package.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
